name: clm
description: Context Language Model mode: Claude edits a mirror file of its own conversation, and the edit becomes its context

budget.title: Token budget
budget.description: Tokens the budget notices and the overflow guard measure against. 0 uses the model's context window.

reminders.title: Budget notices
reminders.description: Budget fractions at which a [CLM BUDGET] note is added to Claude's context.

guard.title: Overflow guard
guard.description: When Claude Code auto-compacts and no edit is pending, withhold the oldest tool results (saved to files) instead of summarizing, if that brings the context under budget.

steering.title: Steering
steering.description: house appends the bundled context-management brief to the system prompt; none keeps the protocol text alone.
